name: questionnaire

frames.best_why: Two answers are ticked and the full question, helper line and footer buttons are all in view.

tagline: Step through questions one at a time, ticking answers as progress counts up.
summary: A multi-step questionnaire showing one question at a time: single or multi-select answer cards, an optional freeform field, a counting progress label, and Previous, Skip and Next buttons that slide between steps.
appearance: A narrow form on black: a small Question 1 of 3 line, a bold question, a grey helper sentence, then stacked rounded answer cards each with a small square or round indicator and a letter at the right. Buttons run along the bottom edge.
behaviour: Choosing an answer fills its indicator with a tick or dot while the card tints. Next slides the current question out and the following one in with a blur and a height change, the progress line counts up, Skip bypasses the question and Save plan replaces Next on the last step.
demo_content: Questions about agent handoffs and progress updates, with answers like Tool call timeline and Approval checkpoints.
search_phrases: multi step survey with one question at a time
choose options then click next flow
onboarding questions with a progress count
skippable questions with a freeform box
guided setup form for a product
how to build a step by step questions form
use_when: A short guided survey or setup flow should ask one thing at a time instead of showing every field at once.
avoid_when: Questions and answers are written into the demo markup, so real survey content means editing and re-authoring the steps.
customise: Compose steps from the Questionnaire parts: items with a title, description, choices and an input, then Previous, Skip, Next and Submit. Question copy is children; timings come from the motion tokens.
weight_why: A few cards and buttons; animations run only when the step or an answer changes.

a11y.note: Real inputs, visible focus rings and labelled groups, with reduced motion falling back to plain fades.

issues: The freeform field in frame 1 has only a placeholder, so it reads as one more answer card rather than a text box.
Answer card borders and helper text are very faint against black, so the options take effort to read.
polish_why: Refined step flow with springy checks and a rolling counter; the options are faint on black.
title: Questionnaire
